config.text:
Namaste 🙏

How many loan files slipped away last month just because a follow-up was missed? 📂

DSA Management keeps every file, follow-up and commission in one place, on your phone. 📱 Your bank DSA code stays 100% yours. This is only software to manage your work.

One quick question 👇 Are you already working as a DSA / loan agent?
Plans start at ₹600/month for individuals and ₹1,397/month for teams.

Thanks! {{agent_intro}} will get back to you shortly. Meanwhile, here's a 2-min video that answers most questions 👇
▶️ English: https://youtu.be/1JD25RJFkOU
▶️ Hindi: https://youtu.be/-4AXco_mN8c
